references.text: The Lord raised up Othniel as the first judge to save Israel from Cushan-Rishathaim, a direct fulfillment of the pattern described in Judges 2:16.
The Lord raised up Ehud as deliverer for Israel, another example of how God sent judges to rescue His people.
Gideon was called by the Lord to save Israel from the Midianites, fulfilling the promise that God would raise up judges.
Samuel mentions how the Lord sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel to deliver Israel from their enemies, summarizing the period of the judges.
Nehemiah confirms that God gave Israel deliverers who rescued them from the hand of their enemies, in line with the pattern found in Judges.
Paul refers to the era of the judges in his speech at Antioch, affirming that God provided Israel with judges until the prophet Samuel.
